text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Seriously, thanks a ton, Rob Roy! 
I managed to track it down thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
My lil sis told me I just HAD to read this 
book, y'know! 
I totally blanked on the title, so I was 
panicking hard~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
When you told me the plot summary you 
remembered, 
I thought it might be that one... 
I'm so glad I could be of help!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If you've got time after this, let me 
thank you properly. 
I've got a hangout spot nearby where we 
always chill!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hey guys, make some room!

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, 'sup, Pokke-san!" 
"...Wait, we got a guest?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, give her the royal treatment. 
She's my savior who helped me out big 
time!

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Course, leave it to us! 
—Whaddya wanna drink? 
Cola, carrot juice, and then...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... umm...! 
Th-there's really no need to trouble 
yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Damn~, ain't she a polite one. 
Uhh, it ain't much of a place, but— 
please, take your time chatting...?

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...If there's anything ya need, don't 
hesitate 
to run us around like errand girls... 
m'lady?

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"What's that supposed to be? You messin' 
around?" 
"Hey, that's my line."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-what should I do... I'm making them 
walk 
on eggshells around me...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(So I don't cause any trouble, I need to 
properly 
blend in...! A-all right...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Then tea. A cup of piping hot tea... 
I reckon I'll partake of, if ya don't 
mind."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? That was right... wasn't it? 
In "Those Who Upheld Honor", 
I'm sure that was how—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I reckon I know my place full well, 
good folks. So please, pay me no mind."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Rob Roy. That way of talking... 
Are you, like, copying some novel?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. When in Rome, do as the Romans do. 
I reckoned I ought to adapt to everyone's 
code here, 
you see."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, I gotcha. 
So that's how we look to you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! All right...! 
Then today, why don't you stick with us 
under that "code" of yours!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Go on, order whatever you like. 
Fries? Nah, how about a special parfait?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"N-nay, Boss! For a mere trifle like that, 
I couldn't possibly accept such lavish 
rewards—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't sweat it, don't sweat it! 
No need to hold back!

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-san, this is your first time 
playing, right? 
Do you know the rules?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Much obliged. Might I trouble you for 
instruction?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through town, I caught sight 
of Zenno Rob Roy 
hanging out and having fun together with 
Jungle Pocket 
and her friends.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ora ora oraaa!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Shoot, Rob Roy! I'm leaving that side to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, right away... Wait, no—!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me, Boss. 
Not even a mouse is gettin' past this 
line!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Hell yeah! New high score for the day!

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, nice going!" 
"Great cover, Rob Roy!"
choice_data_list: What on earth is going on here...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Good work today!
choice_data_list: That was an unusual way of speaking.

You had quite a unique way of speaking 
there.
Were you hanging out with your friends?
Were you playing with your friends?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Good work today!
choice_data_list: That was an unusual way of speaking.

You had quite a unique way of speaking 
there.
Were you hanging out with your friends?
Were you playing with your friends?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You noticed, Trainer...! 
Ehehe... Truth be told, I've managed to 
master a way 
of speaking that lets me blend in with 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's hard for the usual me... 
I figured I could just act like a 
character from a story.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-What do you think? I was able to talk 
naturally 
with Pokke-san's friends... wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy's manner of speaking felt a 
bit off the mark. 
Still, Jungle Pocket's friends 
seemed to receive it quite warmly.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. 
Rather than just friends, they're more 
like—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Sworn homies connected heart-to-heart, ya 
see!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy seemed thrilled 
to have made new friends.
